project.name: VentuSample
project.value_proposition: An offline C++20 generator for repeatable hip-hop loops, parts and one-shot kits with PCM16 WAV assets and a versioned pack manifest.
primary_users: Sound-design learners who need reproducible procedural starting points
jobs_to_be_done: Generate tempo-, key- and style-directed musical material
Create repeatable variations from an explicit seed and parameter snapshot
Export WAV assets and metadata for use in an external DAW

distribution: Source checkout and CMake build of the portable renderer
Qt 6 desktop target when the development SDK is available
commercial_position.support_route: Community issue reporting through the repository's GitHub Issues; no response-time commitment or paid support SLA is offered.
commercial_position.privacy_posture: Offline local rendering; no network telemetry, background capture or implicit native-library loading.

quality.requirement: Repeat a render from the same effective parameters, seed and software version.
Validate PCM16 WAV format, sample rate, byte size and frame count before processing.
Export stereo PCM16 WAV and the versioned pack manifest with per-file measurements.
Describe the sample-peak ceiling accurately and protect the stereo-linked master behavior.
Run the portable build, contract checks and regression tests through CI.

cohesion.requirement: Keep validation, seeded event scheduling, rendering, mastering, measurement and export in one documented flow.
Use one swing and subdivision mapping for drum events and generated melodic accents.
Preserve the documented ventusample.pack.v1 schema and its compatibility boundary.
Protect renderer, WAV I/O and pack export through deterministic regression coverage.
Keep desktop, control, renderer, asset I/O and verification responsibilities explicit.

commercial.requirement: State the sample-pack use case and output contract without presenting the product as a DAW or plugin.
Provide CMake build, test and generation instructions with Qt availability caveats.
Ship the Apache 2.0 license with the source distribution.
Define the portable renderer build and the conditional Qt desktop target.
Validate producer demand, repeated use and willingness to pay before publishing commercial forecasts.
commercial.reason: No public customer interviews, retention metrics or paid demand are currently published.

known_gaps: No price, paid tier, marketplace or paid support SLA is published.
VentuSample is an offline generator, not a DAW, VST/AU plugin, real-time engine or sample marketplace.
Qt desktop compilation depends on an available Qt 6 development kit.
